dcat.description: A tabular dataset providing tick survey results around the Jackson Wyoming area between the dates of Oct 25 2021 and Nov 6 2021. The data compares a dog surveyor to a human surveyor in both transect and survey plots, recording detection events, total number of tick larvae found, and how long the survey took, and the cost of the survey. A second tabular dataset outlining the associated costs for each survey.
